Russet Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: COCquamber
Exhibition name: Home of Time
rows.Origin:
Bred by Anne G. Cocker (1920-2014) (Scotland, 1998).
Introduced in Scotland by James Cocker & Sons in 1998 as 'Home of Time'.
rows.Bloom: Russet. Flowers cinnomon red with bronze shading with lighter reverse. Mild fragrance. 26 to 40 petals. Average diameter 2". Medium, full (26-40 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy, upright. Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 30" to 35" (75 to 90cm). Width: up to 2' (up to 60cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
